summary: 医学知识能指导诊治，人文学科则帮助从业者理解患者的经历和价值。作者回顾医学教育的变化，并以达尔豪斯医学院的课程说明怎样结合这两方面。
logic: 从患者期待谈医学能力
区分医疗的技艺和科学两面
回顾人文学科在教育中的地位
用医学院实践讨论培养效果

paragraphs.brief: 医务人员呼吁人文与技术并重
sentences: In a recent meeting with health professionals from many disciplines, the concept of the humanities and how they enrich the lives and practice of physicians was discussed.
在最近与来自许多学科的保健专业人员举行的会议上，讨论了人文学科的概念以及这些概念如何丰富医生的生活和做法。
There were nurses, chiropractors, speech therapists, health administrators and professionals from a dozen other fields.
有护士、脊椎按摩师、言语治疗师、保健管理人员和来自其他十多个领域的专业人员。

Everyone commented on the need to achieve a balance between the humanities and the skills and technological expertise of their specific discipline, beginning with the experience in medical school and then life in their chosen specialisation, to create fully realised professionals.
与会者都认为，从医学院学习到日后的职业生涯，都应兼顾人文学养与本专业的技能、技术知识，这样才能培养出发展全面的医务人员。
The purpose of my discussion here is to advocate a balanced approach to the education of all health professionals.
我在此讨论的目的是提倡对所有保健专业人员的教育采取平衡的做法。
paragraphs.gist: 来自护理、康复和管理等不同专业的医务人员都认为，医疗教育既需要技能与技术，也应给能够丰富从业者生活和实践的人文学科留出位置。

paragraphs.brief: 患者希望被理解和倾听
sentences: I believe that most people wish to see in their medical professional a person who not only brings excellent skills, techniques and treatments, but also personal qualities that show they are fully developed individuals.
我认为，大多数人希望自己的医疗专业人员不仅能够带来出色的技能、技术和治疗，而且能够带来表明他们已经完全成熟的个人素质。
Such individuals are sensitive, communicative, and understanding of the human condition.
这样的人能体察他人的感受，善于沟通，也理解人的不同处境。
They acknowledge the vast array of backgrounds, views, fears and hopes each person brings to the clinical encounter.
他们承认每个人给临床治疗带来各种各样的背景、观点、恐惧和希望。
paragraphs.gist: 患者期望医务人员不仅医术好，也能倾听和体谅，了解每位患者带入诊室的不同经历、看法、恐惧与希望。

paragraphs.brief: 临床训练留下的人文空白
sentences: The training of health professionals has usually been exemplary in teaching them to recognise and treat a symptom or disease, but often less attentive to the broad education that would inform and educate them about the persons who come from various cultures, backgrounds and experiences.
医务人员的训练向来很擅长教人识别症状、治疗疾病，却往往较少提供能帮助他们了解不同文化、背景和经历的患者的通识教育。
Such understanding does not come from the course textbooks but from literature, history, poetry, art and other aspects of the humanities.
这种理解不是来自课程教科书，而是来自文学、历史、诗歌、艺术和人文学科的其他方面。
paragraphs.gist: 传统培训善于教人识别和治疗疾病，却较少帮助学生理解不同背景的患者，而文学、历史、诗歌和艺术正能补上这种认识。

paragraphs.brief: 把较难衡量的人文能力纳入课程
sentences: There are two sides to the healing profession, once described as the art and the science of medical practice.
治疗专业有两面，曾经被描述为医学实践的艺术和科学。

It is evident, however, that most educational programmes emphasise knowledge, clinical skill and competence, and although educators wish the person to be humanistic, empathetic and communicative, they take this aspect for granted, as if valuable educational time does not need to be allocated to this ‘soft’ feature of the profession.
然而，多数培养方案偏重知识、临床技能和专业能力，教育者虽希望学生通情达理、富有同情心、善于沟通，却常默认这些品质自然会形成，不愿为这些较“软”的素养分配宝贵课时。
It is compounded by the recognition that this aspect is harder to define and measure than knowledge and competence.
更严重的是，人们认识到，这一方面比知识和能力更难界定和衡量。

We may want the health professional to understand many elements of the human condition so they can understand, assess and manage the suffering of patients, but it is harder to design and teach such a course than one on anatomy, for example.
我们或许希望保健专业人员了解人类状况的许多因素，以便他们能够理解、评估和管理病人的痛苦，但设计和教授这种课程要比在解剖学上要困难得多。
Developing a humanities programme in professional education refocuses attention on what everyone recognises as important.
制定专业教育方面的人文方案，使人们重新关注大家认为重要的问题。
Rather than take humanities education for granted, it becomes a direct part of the programme.
把人文教育正式纳入培养方案，才不至于想当然地认为学生自然就会懂得这些。
This signals that the school takes it seriously and encourages activities related to the broad area of the humanities.
这说明学校认真对待这个问题，并鼓励开展与人文领域有关的活动。
paragraphs.gist: 医疗的科学一面容易考核，理解患者处境的能力却较难衡量，把人文教育正式写进课程能让师生知道学校重视这部分训练。

paragraphs.brief: 历史和文学让医生看见人的处境
sentences: Distinguished by their focus on human values, the humanities cover many areas, including history, ethics, literature, theology, art, music, law and the social sciences as they apply to the profession.
人文科学以人类价值观为中心，涵盖许多领域，包括历史、伦理、文学、神学、艺术、音乐、法律和社会科学。
For example, a history of the profession gives us an understanding of how we have come to be where we are, and how things change and progress.
例如，这一职业的历史使我们了解我们是如何走到现在的，以及事情的变化和进展。
Literature can teach us about human hopes and aspirations, suffering and loss, relationships, and life and death.
文学可以教导我们人类的希望和愿望、痛苦和损失、关系以及生死。
Emphasis on human values is important in this day and age as we are increasingly at risk of being overwhelmed by more emotionless technology and complex bureaucracy.
强调人类价值观在当今时代是重要的，因为我们越来越有可能被更多的无情技术和复杂的官僚机构所压倒。
paragraphs.gist: 历史能解释医疗职业如何走到今天，文学能让人理解痛苦、失落与希望，在技术可能压过人的时代，这些学科让人的价值始终在场。

paragraphs.brief: 医学课程为何转向科学
sentences: In medical education during the 18th and 19th centuries, there was an emphasis on the humanities.
在18世纪和19世纪的医学教育中，强调了人文科学。

As time went on, encouraged by increasing interest in medical sciences, laboratory experiments and technological aspects of the profession, emphasis in medical studies was weighted towards courses in the sciences.
随着时间的流逝，由于对医学、实验室实验和专业技术方面的兴趣日益浓厚，医学研究的重点已转向科学课程。
The Flexner Report in 1910 recognised the variable quality of medical education and the need to have better teaching in the medical sciences and laboratory methods.
1910 年的《弗莱克斯纳报告》指出医学教育质量参差不齐，有必要改进医学和实验方法的教学。
This resulted in a pendulum swing in emphasis, directing the curriculum to the medical sciences, to the exclusion of the humanities, an imbalance never intended by Flexner.
这导致重点的摆动，将课程引向医学，而排除人文科学，这种不平衡从来不是Flexner所想的。
paragraphs.gist: 医学教育原本重视人文，后来随着实验与技术兴起，尤其是 1910 年的弗莱克斯纳报告推动科学教学后，课程重心便转向医学科学。

paragraphs.brief: 达尔豪西医学院的人文活动
sentences: Currently at Dalhousie Medical School we have elective programmes in the humanities, summer research studentships, lecture series, presentations and discussions.
达尔豪西医学院目前提供人文选修课、暑期研究资助，以及系列讲座、报告和讨论活动。
There is an artist-in-residence programme that brings artists to the school.
学校有一个艺术家常住方案，让艺术家来学校。
There is a large choir of over a hundred students and faculty, a concert band, a string ensemble, and groups of student artists who put on regular performances and exhibitions.
有一支由100多名学生和教师组成的大合唱团、一个音乐乐队、一个弦合奏团，以及一些学生艺术家团体，他们定期举办表演和展览。
The list of activities is much longer, but it should be pointed out that these provide some balance and broaden the life and learning of the student.
活动清单要长得多，但应该指出，这些活动提供了某种平衡，扩大了学生的生活和学习。
paragraphs.gist: 达尔豪西医学院通过选修课、暑期研究、驻校艺术家和师生乐团等项目，让学生在临床学习之外也能接触人文学科、发展个人兴趣。

paragraphs.brief: 学校认可兴趣如何改变心态
sentences: Perhaps more important than the activities themselves is the change in mind-set that occurs when students see that diversity in their studies and activities is legitimised and encouraged.
比活动本身或许更重要的，是学生发现学校认可并鼓励多样化的学习和活动后，心态发生了变化。
We emphasise that we want students and faculty to continue to express interests and talents they had before entering medical school.
我们希望师生在进入医学院后，仍能发挥原有的兴趣和才能。
They now come forward with ideas and activities that are more imaginative and exciting than we could have designed.
现在，他们提出了比我们设计得更富有想象力和更加令人振奋的想法和活动。
They also comment that the humanities has made medical school a more enjoyable and fulfilling experience.
他们还评论说，人文学科使医学院成为更令人愉快和充实的经历。
Students see that their learning and their lives can be more balanced, making them better equipped to care for their patients.
学生们看到，他们的学习和生活可以更加平衡，使他们更有能力照顾病人。
paragraphs.gist: 学校对人文兴趣的认可改变了师生心态，学生主动提出新活动，觉得医学院生活更充实，也相信平衡的学习生活有助于照顾病人。

paragraphs.brief: 人文教育的价值如何判断
sentences: Will involvement in the humanities make one a better health professional?
参与人文学科会成为一个更好的保健专业人员吗？
It’s a question often asked of today’s medical professionals but very difficult to document in this evidence-based era of medicine.
也很难在这个以证据为基础的医学时代记录下来。
But as ethics scholars have said of learning ethics, it cannot guarantee that a person will be more ethical, but it is more likely than not.
但是，正如伦理学学者所说，学习伦理，它不能保证一个人会更加道德，但可能性更大。

My firm belief is that all the healing professions should increase the balance of humanities with the traditional educational emphasis on skills and knowledge, and this will benefit both the healers and those who need to be healed.
我坚信，所有从事诊疗照护的专业都应在传统的知识技能教学之外，更加重视人文教育，让医务人员和求医者都能受益。
paragraphs.gist: 人文学习能否直接造就更好的医务人员很难用证据量化，但作者以伦理教育为类比，主张让人文训练与专业知识并重，使医患双方受益。

items.en: An approach that incorporates the humanities is more important for some medical disciplines than others.
items.zh: 纳入人文科学的方法对某些医学学科比其他学科更为重要。
items.why: “all health professionals”=对所有学科与专业都要平衡。“balanced approach”=将人文纳入而非偏科。

items.en: Most people value medical expertise over sensitivity in their medical professionals.
items.zh: 大多数人都把医疗专业知识放在其医疗专业人员的敏感性之上。
items.why: “not only…but also"=婚要技术也要敏感/沟通。并未说“skills over sensitivity”(更看重)

items.en: Most medical programmes devote little course time to developing interpersonal skills.
items.zh: 多数医学培养方案用于训练人际交往能力的课时很少。
items.why: “for granted / does not need to be allocated”= 几平不专门分配课时。“less attentive”= 投入少。人文 = 同题干的“interpersonal skills (人际 / 沟通 )”

items.en: It is more difficult to design a humanities course for health professionals than a medical one.
items.zh: 为卫生专业人员设计人文科课程比为医疗专业人员设计课程更为困难。
items.why: “harder to design and teach”=更难设计与教授。“anatomy”=典型医学课程。

items.en: It would be best if a medical programme included a course about the lives of medical professionals.
items.zh: 医学培养方案最好设一门介绍医务工作者生活的课程。
items.why: 医学院设有人文选修、研究项目和讲座。作者支持人文教育，但没有推荐一门专讲医务人员生平或生活的课程。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: What unforeseen result did the Flexner report have?
items.zh: 《弗莱克斯纳报告》带来了什么出乎意料的影响？
correct: It moved the focus of medical studies away from the humanities.
它使医学教育的重心偏离了人文学科。

items.en: The writer lists humanities activities at Dalhousie Medical School to show how these activities
items.zh: 作者列出达尔豪西医学院的文科活动，以展示这些活动

items.en: How do students at Dalhousie Medical School react to humanities activities?
items.zh: Dalhousie医学院的学生对人文活动有何反应？
correct: They report feeling that medical school has become more engaging and satisfying.
他们觉得医学院生活变得更有吸引力，也更充实。

items.en: What is the writer’s main conclusion?
items.zh: 作者的主要结论是什么？
correct: Greater emphasis on humanities in medical schools will benefit both patients and practitioners.
在医学院中更加重视人文科学，将使病人和从业者都受益。

items.en: Health professionals at a recent seminar discussed a need for educational institutions to
items.zh: 在最近举行的一次研讨会上，卫生专业人员讨论了教育机构有必要
items.answer: G · provide more equal coverage of both medical knowledge and skills, and humanities.
items.solution: 在医学知识、临床技能与人文教育之间取得更好的平衡。

items.answer: F · give less attention to broad education and more to recognising and treating symptoms.
items.solution: 较少注意广泛的教育，更多地注意识别和治疗症状。

items.en: The interpersonal and behavioural aspects of medical practice
items.zh: 医疗实践的人际关系和行为方面
items.answer: B · are difficult to describe with any precision.

items.en: Dalhousie Medical School students and faculty
items.zh: 达尔豪西医学院学生和教职员工
items.answer: A · generate innovative and creative suggestions for activities and programmes.
items.solution: 为活动和方案提出创新和创造性的建议。

items.answer: C · find it difficult to prove statistically the benefits of humanities programmes.
items.solution: 发现很难从统计上证明人文方案的好处。

pairs: 第 4 段 · 第 6 句
第 5 段 · 第 1 句
points: “not only…but also"=婚要技术也要敏感/沟通。并未说“skills over sensitivity”(更看重)
题干问“多数医疗培训方案”。定位句写到“医务人员的训练向来很擅长教人识别症状、治疗疾病，却往往较少提供能帮助他们了解不同文化、背景和经历的患者的通识教育”。
clauses: It is evident, however, that most educational programmes emphasise knowledge, clinical skill and competence, and …, they take this aspect for granted, as if valuable educational time does not need to be allocated to this ‘soft’ feature of the profession.
连接词 although 引出“although educators wish the person to be humanistic, empathetic and communicative”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
“that brings artists to the school”修饰前面的 programme。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 programme，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Professor Jock Murray from Dalhousie Medical School in Canada writes about the role of humanities in the education of health professionals
加拿大达尔豪西医学院的乔克·默里教授撰文讨论人文学科在医务人员教育中的作用。
vocabulary: 能设身处地理解他人的
